records.program_m_observation: Whole-relation invariants were reported to preserve identity; orientation reversal was duality rather than exact identity; OTM was reconstructive.
records.program_s_observation: Observed-slice and closure equality were reported to collapse distinct pre-closure structures under the tested standard equivalence models.
records.comparative_ruling: The reported disagreement is bounded to the tested representation and equivalence predicates.
representation_losses: Qualitative roles mapped to string categories.

records.program_m_observation: Under tested perturbations, I1 symmetry reference, I2 orientation roles, and I3 distinction capacity were classified as necessary.
records.program_s_observation: The report states that the corresponding pointed-structure audit agreed on the three-element candidate basis.
records.comparative_ruling: Candidate minimality is supported only for the tested finite constructions and is not a proof of universal minimality.
representation_losses: Invariants mapped to discrete structural classes.

records.program_m_observation: The report states that all tested construction orders except I1→I2→I3 collapse or become inert, and two-invariant subsets fail to realize the triplet.

records.comparative_ruling: Whole-expression dependence is supported in the tested model; it does not prove uniqueness outside the tested constructions.
